# TASK-621: Size objects and keep them fresh

## Goal

Measure an object's recursive size and file count without storing per-file rows, mark it dirty from the existing file-system event stream, and re-measure on a bounded schedule so freshness is stated rather than assumed.

## Deliverables

- Aggregate sizing and dirty-marking
